q.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
q.text: Betty interviews Mr. Harrington about Peter for the school news, and he admits his ex-wife now believes the Mysterio theories.
q.on_a_card_about_b: Betty's teacher, whom she interviews about Peter.
q.on_b_card_about_a: Harrington's student, who interviews him about Peter.

why: The facts are right: in the extended cut Betty interviews Harrington about being Peter's teacher, and he says his ex-wife now believes the Mysterio theories. Apply this stage only if the owner says yes to item 17 (it is not in the theatrical cut).

q.on_b_card_about_a: Dell's student, who interviews him about Peter.

why: The facts are right: in the extended cut Betty interviews her history teacher Dell, and he tells her what he would be if he were Spider-Man. Apply this stage only if the owner says yes to item 17 (it is not in the theatrical cut).

q: Two stages rest only on the extended cut (Spider-Man: No Way Home, The More Fun Stuff Version): Betty interviewing Harrington and Dell for the school news. Count extended-cut scenes as part of the film?
why: The rules say only what is on screen and never mention alternate cuts. The More Fun Stuff Version is an official release that was shown in theaters, but it is not the standard cut, so the owner has to decide.
